scope: Implementation-independent V0-relative acceptance; not HF accuracy certification
quick: Six frozen cases; development gate only
full_logits: All 34 frozen histories, including 8192 tokens; every sampled full-vocabulary vector must pass
hidden_states: Optional diagnostics after failure, at meaningful layer boundaries
legacy_operator_checks: Diagnostics for implementations that retain those operators; not a universal fusion requirement
release_also_requires: Actual production prefill/decode paths exercised by the model probe
Tokenizer and sampling regressions with CPU AddressSanitizer enabled
CUDA memcheck on the actual optimized model path, including long context
Matching model, workload and timing configuration for benchmark comparisons
fusion: Validate the output of the fused computation or full model; do not require nonexistent intermediate tensors
